notes:
- Entry forms open as pop-ups over the page you are on: new account, accrual, collection / payment and transfer, also from buttons above the lists and on the account card
- One screen for accruals (receivable or payable) and one for collections and payments; the direction is the first choice
- Transfer: move all or part of an account's open balance to another account in the same unit; both sides are cancelled together
- Home page can be customized: add, remove and reorder sections, including new ones for overdue and upcoming installments, collections by payment method and recent records
- New report: monthly accruals and payments, with months as columns (employees by period, students and others by due month)
- Account statement without choosing an account: a summary of all accounts with filters, opening the statement with one click
- Due tracking and due report: filter by open or settled, totals per currency on the right, amounts in the base currency
- Shorter document numbers (for example AL-0001)
- New account type: Student
- Compact row spacing by default; the session closes after 1 minute without activity
- Collections and payments no longer ask for a transaction category
